title: The Wonderful Counsellor
overview: Dr. Michael Williams, a psychologist, runs a practice that is struggling to get new clients and keep the ones he currently has. His traditional approach as a therapist, and his conservative values, have made it difficult for him to connect with people. His Wife Chloe is successful and runs her own Coffee shop, however she's unhappy in her marriage due to the difficulties with Michael’s practice, and unwillingness to try new methods. After Chloe suggests a divorce, Michael records his feelings and accidentally posts it online. The video becomes Viral and Chloe is not too happy.
